name: Responsive Modern Slider
author: watson-77

sections.description:
Responsive modern slider with title in bottom caption. Built with Bootstrap 5, supports custom fields, and offers multiple styling options.

Plugin slider with advanced features four types of sliders within the plugin: https://garmoniagroup.ru/digitalshop/wordpress-plagin-slayder/

Плагин слайдера с расширенными возможностями четыре разновидности слайдеров в одном плагине: https://garmoniagroup.ru/digitalshop/wordpress-plagin-slayder/

Developer: Konstantin Milyushenko (watson-77)
Developer site: https://dev.apicoder.ru
Version 3.0.1: Improved design, new shortcode attributes, enhanced TinyMCE integration.
sections.installation:
1. Unzip responsive-modern-slider.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
A question that someone might have

Please refer to the plugin page or the developer’s site for more information.
sections.changelog:
3.0.1

  • Improved slider design with smooth animations, parallax effect, and modern navigation buttons.
  • Added shortcode attributes: interval, pause, wrap, keyboard for full control.
  • Enhanced TinyMCE button with a comprehensive dialog to set all options.
  • Optimized CSS for better responsiveness and visual appeal.
  • When you activate the plugin, a test slider with three sample slides is automatically created. The test images are built into the plugin, so you can immediately see how the slider works and use it as a basis for your own projects.

3.0

  • Complete code rewrite: integrated Extended_Post_Meta_Box, added repeater fields, Bootstrap 5 support.

2.0.1

  • Code update, structure update, framework update.

2.0

  • New index version and fixed height images in slider.

0.2

  • Fixed minor bugs.

0.1

  • Initial lite version.
